column1: # V-memory recall benchmark — fixed queries with a known answer in THIS repo (idea 5,
# /private/tmp/.../mem-research.md). Format: query<TAB>expected_path_substring[,alternative]<TAB>group
# group in {en, ru, ru-pure, ru-translated, paraphrase} — splits the bench totals; en/ru/paraphrase are all "real
# questions with known answers", not synthetic. Every row was verified against the real repo
# index (2026-09-24) with `bench --queries tests/memory-queries.tsv --top 4 --no-embed`; the
# paraphrase rows are DESIGNED to miss under FTS5-only (no lexical overlap with the target
# doc) — that miss is the point, not a bug. Real hit/miss numbers belong in release notes, not
# invented here; this file only fixes the QUERIES so the numbers stay comparable run to run.
# ru rows carry an English anchor token (a flag, a key, a model name); ru-pure rows carry none —
# they measure genuine cross-lingual recall. ru-translated rows are the SAME questions as ru-pure,
# translated to English the way /v:remember now asks the calling agent to do before searching.
